strategy_vs_analysis.reason: The target SEG1 (1.06M, 23% intent, the highest of the four groups) and the tax-estimate positioning follow from the analysis, and the 58% "do not understand tax" figure supports the value proposition. Price is set below 7.20 and Fatture in Cloud's post-promotion 8 euros, with the untested risk acknowledged. The gap is that the channel choice is only partly argued (no channel figures) and the 5-7 euro range is recommended despite intent being measured only at 9 euros, which the plan itself flags.

campaign_vs_strategy.reason: Every campaign message speaks to flat-rate freelancers without an app and carries the tax-estimate, SdI and stable-price positioning, with no F24 claim or uniqueness claim. Channels used (search/SEO, price-comparison and review sites, accountants, professional associations) match the strategy exactly, and the accountant message keeps the accountant in the workflow as the strategy requires.
